# SelecSLS

**Category:** CNN · **Code:**
[`timm/models/selecsls.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/selecsls.py) ·
**Architectures:** 5 · **Pretrained weights:** 3 (3 with ImageNet-1k results)

SelecSLS uses selective long and short range skip connections, proposed as the core network of XNect, a real-time
multi-person 3D pose estimation system.

## Papers

* [XNect: Real-time Multi-Person 3D Motion Capture with a Single RGB Camera](https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.00837)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('selecsls60.in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`SelecSls` with `selecsls42` at 224), other
architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for details.
